adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `loadUsers` was rewritten to wrap everything in a `try/catch`. The `catch` maps `Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError` to `new HttpError({ statusCode: 400, message: error.message })`, which incorrectly treats DB/Prisma failures as client errors. Also, the intentionally thrown `new Error("dynamicUserList is not properly defined or empty.")` is not an `HttpError`/Prisma error, so it is converted into a generic `HttpError` 500 with message `"Unable to load users"`, losing the original message. The catch block does not log the original error at all, so root cause visibility is reduced. These behaviors are directly shown in the diffed `loadUsers` implementation.
